before-buying-a-house.npc: Hello. Welcome to the Gielinor Housing Agency! What can I do for you?

options.text: How can I get a house?

steps.player: How can I get a house?

steps.npc: I can sell you a starting house in Rimmington for 1000 coins. As you increase your construction skill you will be able to have your house moved to other areas and redecorated in other styles.
Do you want to buy a starter house?

steps.text: If the player does not have enough coins:

steps.player: I haven't got 1,000 coins on me.

steps.npc: Well come back when you have it then.
Thank you. Go through the Rimmington house portal and you will find your house ready for you to start building in it.
This book will help you to start building your house.

steps.text: a Construction guide

steps.npc: Well enjoy your player-owned cardboard box or wherever you're going to sleep tonight!
It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.

steps.player: Ah, so that's how everyone can have a house without them cluttering up the world!

steps.npc: Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.
You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.

options.text: Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
options.condition: If player doesn't have level 99 Construction:

steps.player: Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.

steps.npc: As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilities I wear this Skillcape of Construction.
If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!

options.text: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?

steps.player: Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?

steps.npc: Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 99,000 coins:

steps.player: But, unfortunately, I don't have enough money with me.

steps.npc: Well, come back and see me when you do.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins but not enough inventory space:

steps.npc: Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.

steps.text: If the player has at least 99,000 coins and enough inventory space:
a Construction cape and hood

steps.npc: Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
